derivedItems.policy: role=ood_negative_derived. SYNTHETIC or derived OOD probes added by wave-e/e11-ood-expansion: still images, still-image-as-video, program-generated graphics, corrupt/truncated media, and extreme aspect ratios. Derived from the CC BY 3.0 item yt--wE27MoX2AM-tennis (whose license permits redistributed derivatives with attribution) or generated locally with ffmpeg lavfi / seeded PRNG byte edits (no external rights). These exist ONLY to measure the pre-analysis OOD gate; excluded from corpus, splits, training, and every positive-label pipeline. Kept in a separate section because items[] is real, non-synthetic footage by policy.
derivedItems.generation: Deterministic recipes recorded per item; ffmpeg 4.4.2, libx264; PRNG edits use recorded python random seeds.
